email.password_reset.subject: Reset your Sphericon password
email.password_reset.intro: Follow this link to set a new password:
email.email_verify.subject: Verify your Sphericon email
email.email_verify.intro: Follow this link to confirm your email address and set your password:
email.email_change.subject: Confirm your new Sphericon email
email.email_change.intro: Follow this link to confirm your new email address:
email.address_taken.subject: Someone tried to use your email on Sphericon
email.address_taken.intro: Someone tried to sign up, or to move an account, with this email address, which already has a Sphericon account. Nothing was changed.
email.address_taken.sign_in: If it was you, sign in:
email.address_taken.reset: If you forgot your password, reset it:
email.user_deletion.subject: Confirm deleting your Sphericon user
email.user_deletion.intro: You asked to delete your Sphericon user. Open this link while signed in and finish the deletion; it works once and expires in an hour. If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: nothing is deleted.
email.passkey_added.subject: A passkey was added to your Sphericon account
email.passkey_added.intro: The passkey "{{.Name}}" was added to your Sphericon account. You can now sign in with it, and every other session of yours has ended.
email.passkey_removed.subject: A passkey was removed from your Sphericon account
email.passkey_removed.intro: The passkey "{{.Name}}" was removed from your Sphericon account. It can no longer sign anyone in, and every other session of yours has ended.
email.passkey_changed.not_me: If you did not do this, someone has access to your account. Reset your password and contact the administrator of your Sphericon instance.
email.user_deleted.subject: Your Sphericon user was deleted
email.user_deleted.intro: The Sphericon user with this email address was deleted at its owner's request: its workspace memberships, sign-in methods and second factor are gone, and every session has ended.
email.user_deleted.not_me: If you did not do this, someone had your password. Contact the administrator of your Sphericon instance.
email.identity_linked.subject: A sign-in provider was linked to your Sphericon account
email.identity_linked.intro: {{.Provider}} was linked to your Sphericon account: it can now be used to sign in with this email address.
email.identity_linked.not_me: If this was not you, follow this link to unlink it and sign out everywhere:
email.auth.footer: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.
email.welcome.subject: Welcome to Sphericon
email.welcome.body:
Hi {{.Greeting}},

Welcome to Sphericon! Your account is ready.
email.workspace_suspended.subject: Outbound email sending is suspended for {{.Workspace}}
email.webhook_disabled.subject: A webhook endpoint in {{.Workspace}} was disabled
email.webhook_disabled.reason_gone: The receiver answered 410 Gone, which means it no longer wants these requests.
email.webhook_disabled.reason_persistent: Deliveries kept failing: at least {{.Failures}} in a row over more than {{.Window}}.
email.sending_domain_unverified.subject: Action required: sending domain {{.Domain}} is no longer verified
email.sending_domain_unverified.body:
The sending domain "{{.Domain}}" in your workspace is no longer verified: its DKIM DNS record ({{.Record}}) could not be found.

Email sent from this domain is now blocked until you re-publish the record and re-verify the domain in your Sphericon settings.
email.join_domain_unverified.subject: Action required: join domain {{.Domain}} is no longer verified
email.join_domain_unverified.body:
The join domain "{{.Domain}}" of your workspace is no longer verified: its TXT record ({{.Record}}) could not be found, or another workspace now proves the domain.

People with an address on this domain can no longer join your workspace by themselves. Members who already joined stay. To turn it back on, publish the record again and verify the domain in your workspace settings.
email.tracking_domain_regressed.subject: Action required: tracking domain {{.Host}} stopped working
email.tracking_domain_regressed.body:
The tracking domain "{{.Host}}" of your sending domain "{{.Domain}}" is now {{.To}} instead of {{.From}}: its CNAME must point at {{.Target}} and the host must answer over HTTPS.

Links in your email fall back to the app address until it works again.
email.abuse_warning.subject: Warning: email deliverability problem in {{.Workspace}}
email.abuse_warning.body:
Your Sphericon workspace {{.Workspace}} is close to having its sending suspended.

The {{.Metric}} rate on {{.Domain}} is {{.Rate}} over the last 24 hours ({{.Count}} of {{.Total}}), over the warning limit of {{.Limit}}.

Nothing is frozen yet. Clean your list and review who you send to: if the rate reaches the freeze limit, all sending for the workspace is suspended automatically.

{{if .Support}}Questions? Email {{.Support}}.{{end}}
email.second_factor_required.subject: {{.Workspace}} now requires two-factor authentication
email.second_factor_required.body:
The Sphericon workspace {{.Workspace}} now requires every member to sign in with two-factor authentication.

Set it up by {{.Deadline}}, or add a Passkey and sign in with it. After that, {{.Workspace}} is unavailable to you until you do; your other workspaces are not affected.

Set up two-factor authentication or a Passkey:

{{.Link}}
email.second_factor_reminder.subject: One day left to set up two-factor authentication for {{.Workspace}}
email.second_factor_reminder.body:
The Sphericon workspace {{.Workspace}} requires two-factor authentication, and you have not set it up yet.

Your access to {{.Workspace}} is withheld from {{.Deadline}} until you do, unless you sign in with a Passkey.

Set up two-factor authentication or a Passkey:

{{.Link}}
